card.name: Words leading up to a rule or ban
card.fires_on: Small words and modifiers just before a noun like prohibition, rule, restriction or requirement, e.g. 'absolute', 'the', 'which' after a named rule. It also fires inside rule-like words.

modes.label: Modifier before ban
modes.description: An adjective or article right before the expected word prohibition, restriction or rule.
modes.example: In Islam, there is an<< absolute>> prohibition on the consumption of all alcoholic beverages

modes.label: Inside a rule phrase
modes.description: Part of a named rule or a limit, where the next word is rule or limitation.

modes.label: Linking word after a rule
modes.description: A word like which or this after a rule or restriction, leading into what it prohibits.
modes.example: the back-pass rule,<< which>> prohibits goalkeepers from handling the ball with

card.writes: It pushes the model to predict words like restriction, prohibition, rule and requirement next.
card.plain: It lights up when the text is heading toward a word meaning a rule, ban or restriction.
